title: Вопрос у барной стойки  (A Question at the Bar)

segments.t: Max has fled, and Vika wants to know why. She walks up to the bar and questions Kostya, who is Max's best friend and a poor liar. See what you can catch.
Почему Макс так быстро убежал отсюда?
Он просто очень спешил на кухню.
Мне кажется, он странно себя ведёт.
Он ничего не говорил тебе обо мне?
Мы говорили только о нашей работе.
Ты точно говоришь мне чистую правду?
Конечно, я никогда тебя не обманываю.
Хорошо, тогда я спрошу его сама.
Лучше сейчас не трогать его, Вика.
Here's what is going on, line by line.

'Kostya, have you finished preparing the drinks?' 'finished' is used here is the expression Max used for whipping the cream. 'drinks' is used here grows from 'to drink' is used here. Vika starts with a work question.

'Yes, all orders are already ready.' Listen to how 'ready' has the multiple ending to match Listen to how 'orders'. The root for "orders" means a restaurant order, not a command. Kostya answers fast, perhaps too fast.
Почему Макс так быстро убежал отсюда?

'Why did Max run away from here so quickly?' The speaker uses 'ran away' keeps the starting bit meaning "away". The phrase "from here" is one word, one of a trio with the words for "here" and "to here".
Он просто очень спешил на кухню.

'He was simply in a big hurry to get to the kitchen.' Past time frame here is just the he-word past time frame ending on the stem for "hurry", with no They express 'was' by. Going somewhere changes the ending of They express 'kitchen' by after the connecting word. Kostya's excuse sounds more like a lie than the truth.
Мне кажется, он странно себя ведёт.

'It seems to me that he is behaving strangely.' The phrase "to me it seems" is the pattern you have heard. We hear 'behaving' is literally "leads himself", the behave phrase from the dining room scene. We hear 'strangely' is an adverb.

'Max is always a slightly strange guy.' When they say 'guy' is casual, the way English says "bloke". When they say 'strange' is an descriptive word, and When they say 'slightly' means "a bit". Kostya tries to turn the oddness into a fact about Max.
Он ничего не говорил тебе обо мне?

'Did he not say anything to you about me?' Notice the part 'about me' shows how the connecting word "about" grows an extra syllable before Notice the part 'me', to make the cluster easier to say. Notice the part 'not say anything' is literally "nothing not said". Vika has a pretty good guess.
Мы говорили только о нашей работе.

'We spoke only about our work.' After the connecting word "about", both words for "our work" change their endings. In Russian, 'only' translates sits right before what it limits, as "only" does in English. Kostya sounds like a witness who has rehearsed his statement.
Ты точно говоришь мне чистую правду?
'Are you definitely telling me the pure truth?' Russian says "clean truth" for the plain truth. Here, 'truth' shows is the base of Here, 'not true' shows from the chocolate scene. Vika presses.
Конечно, я никогда тебя не обманываю.

'Of course, I never deceive you.' The way to express 'never deceive' uses the double negative Russian requires. The way to express 'I deceive' is a strong word. Kostya says it solemnly, and the lie is plain.
Хорошо, тогда я спрошу его сама.

'Fine, then I will ask him myself.' Russian has two words for "ask". One is to ask a question, as here; the other is to ask for something, as in a previous scene. 'myself' is used here has the she-word ending for a woman.
Лучше сейчас не трогать его, Вика.

'It is better not to disturb him right now, Vika.' Listen to how 'not to disturb him' is literally "not to touch him", which is the Russian for "leave him alone". The first word means "better". Kostya gives a last, feeble piece of advice. Now you can hear it all again.
Почему Макс так быстро убежал отсюда?
Он просто очень спешил на кухню.
Мне кажется, он странно себя ведёт.
Он ничего не говорил тебе обо мне?
Мы говорили только о нашей работе.
Ты точно говоришь мне чистую правду?
Конечно, я никогда тебя не обманываю.
Хорошо, тогда я спрошу его сама.
Лучше сейчас не трогать его, Вика.
Kostya has told her nothing, and Vika decides to ask Max herself. Kostya advises against it, with little hope. Until the next scene.
